model.name: LAMMPS liquid self-diffusion
model.description: Compare self-diffusion in a Lennard-Jones liquid at two temperatures using independent molecular dynamics trajectories.

temperature_reduced.description: Equilibration temperature in Lennard-Jones reduced units. The baseline temperature is fixed at 1.0.

baseline_diffusion_reduced.description: Mean of three fitted self-diffusion coefficients at the baseline temperature, in reduced units.

diffusion_reduced.description: Mean of three fitted self-diffusion coefficients at the chosen temperature, in reduced units.

baseline_diffusion_std_reduced.description: Sample standard deviation of the baseline coefficients, in reduced units.

diffusion_std_reduced.description: Sample standard deviation of the coefficients at the chosen temperature, in reduced units.

max_energy_drift_per_particle_reduced.description: Largest absolute deviation of sampled energy per particle from its value at the start of production across the six runs, in reduced units.

msd_csv.description: Time, mean-squared displacement and total energy per particle for all six replicas, in reduced units.

diffusion_plot_png.description: Mean squared displacement over time at both temperatures, with replica spread and the fitting window.
